ref: Esi dumeviawo ƒo ƒu ɖe Buckingham fiasã me nɔ nyadzɔdzɔ si ku ɖe Fianyɔnua ƒe lãmesẽ ŋu lalam la, wo dometɔ aɖewo fa avi esi wose Fianyɔnua ƒe ku.

text: Malaria testing kits are helping people living in rural remote areas in the absence of a doctor
ref: Nugbagbevi suesuesue siwo wowɔ kpɔ la le kpekpem ɖe ame siwo le nuto siwo me kɔƒe didiwo me ne ɖɔkta aɖeke mele o la ŋu
translated: Asrã dodokpɔ dɔwɔnuwo le kpekpem ɖe ame siwo nɔa kɔƒenuto didiwo me ŋu ne atikewɔla aɖeke mele o.

text: The district has properly planned for the youths and their future.
ref: Nutomea wɔ ɖoɖo nyuie ɖe sɔhɛawo kple woƒe etsɔme ŋu.

text: The support team helped her with her basic needs.

text: The headteacher was sacked over alleged involvement in the last week strike.

text: The pope is the chief pastor of the worldwide catholic church.
ref: Popue nye nunɔla ga ne katoliko hame la le xexe blibo la katã me.
translated: Papa lae nye xexeame katã ƒe Katoliko hame la ƒe pastɔ gã.

text: Some poor people consume all their money with holding back any little for savings.
ref: Ame dahe aɖewo ɖua woƒe gawo katã eye wometea ŋu ɖua ga o.

text: The Mayor made sure all the roads in our town are properly constructed.
ref: Dumegã la kpɔ egbɔ be wotu mɔ siwo katã le míaƒe dua me la nyuie.
translated: Dumegã la kpɔ egbɔ be wowɔ mɔ siwo katã le míaƒe dua me la nyuie.

text: The district will enforce environmental laws with an aim of conserving the environment.
ref: Nutomea awɔ nu sia nu si wòate ŋui atsɔ akpɔ nutoa me ƒe dedienɔnɔ ta.
translated: Nutome la akpɔ egbɔ be wowɔ ɖe dzɔdzɔme ŋuti sewo dzi kple taɖodzinu be woakpɔ dzɔdzɔme la ta.

text: We were educated about self-defense as people are always educated on how to protect children's rights in the community.
ref: Wofia nu mí tso ɖokui taʋiʋli ŋu elabena wofiaa nu amewo ɣesiaɣi tso alesi woakpɔ ɖeviwo ƒe gomenɔamesiwo ta le nutoa me ŋu.
translated: Míexɔ hehe le ame ɖokui ta kpɔkpɔ ŋu abe ale si amewo xɔa hehe ɣesiaɣi le ale si woakpɔ ɖeviwo ƒe gomekpɔkpɔwo ta le nutoa me ŋu ene.

text: Roads should be constructed in areas which are not linked with people's land.
ref: Ele be woatu mɔwo ɖe nuto siwo me womate ŋu ado ƒome kple amewo ƒe anyigba o la me o.
translated: Ele be woatu mɔwo ɖe teƒe siwo medo ka kple amewo ƒe anyigba o.

text: She constantly strives for excellence in her work, and never settles for mediocrity.
ref: Edzea agbagba ɣesiaɣi be yeawɔ nu nyui na yeƒe dɔwo, eye gbeɖegbeɖea koe.
translated: Edzea agbagba ɣesiaɣi be yeawɔ yeƒe dɔ wòanyo ŋutɔ, eye melɔ̃na ɖe dɔ tsɛ dzi gbeɖe o.

text: In severe cases, it can cause jaundice, seizures, coma, or death.

text: Archaeological remains found in the coastal zone indicate that the area has been inhabited since the Bronze Age (ca. 2000 BC), but these societies, based on fishing in the extensive lagoons and rivers, have left few traces.
ref: Nu gbagbeŋutinunyala siwo kpɔtɔ le ƒutanutoa me ɖee fia be tso Bronze Ƒe (ca.20000 BC) me la, nutoa me tɔwo nɔa nutoa me, gake habɔbɔ siawo nɔa tɔmelã siwo le tɔmelãwo me kple tɔsisiwo me la me.
translated: Blemanunuku me nususɔ siwo wofɔ le ƒuta nutoa me ɖee fia be amewo nɔ nutoa me tso Akɔbli Ɣeyiɣia me (abe ƒe 2000 D.Ŋ.K. ene), gake ameha siawo, siwo ƒe agbenɔnɔ nɔ te ɖe tɔƒodede le ta kple tɔsisi gãwo me dzi la, dzesi ʋɛ aɖewo ko wogblẽ ɖi.

text: True to his promise to reduce the number of Ministerial appointees and run a lean government, the number of Ministers was significantly reduced from 87 of the previous Kufuor NPP government to 73 (a reduction of 16%) in the Mills-led government.
ref: Abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe be yeaɖe amesiwo wotia be woanye dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe xexlẽme dzi akpɔtɔ eye yeana dziɖuɖua nanɔ te sesĩe ene la, woɖe dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe xexlẽme dzi kpɔtɔ tso 87 le Kufuor NPP dziɖuɖua si va yi me va ɖo 73 (si nye 16%) le Mills dziɖuɖua me.
translated: Le eƒe ŋugbedodo be yeaɖe Dɔdzikpɔla siwo woɖo ƒe xexlẽme dzi akpɔtɔ ahakpɔ dziɖuɖu si me amewo mesɔ gbɔ fũu o dzi nu la, woɖe Dɔdzikpɔlawo ƒe xexlẽme dzi akpɔtɔ ŋutɔ tso 87 le Kufuor ƒe NPP dziɖuɖu si va yi la me va ɖo 73 (si nye 16% ƒe dzikpɔkpɔtɔ) le dziɖuɖu si Mills xɔ ŋgɔ na la me.

text: Aeroplanes serve as the fastest method of transportation today.
ref: Aƒetɔviwo wɔa dɔ egbea be ʋuwo ƒe mɔ kpuietɔ kekeake.
translated: Yameʋuwoe nye mɔzɔmɔnu si zɔna kaba wu katã egbea.

text: The peoples' hostility is complicating the health workers' job of suppressing outbreaks.
ref: Ameawo ƒe fuléle le lãmesẽdɔwɔlawo ƒe dɔ si nye be woatsi dɔvɔ̃wo nu la le sesẽm ɖe edzi.
translated: Amewo ƒe adãdodo le kuxi dom na lãmesẽdɔwɔlawo ƒe dɔ si nye mɔxexe na dɔvɔ̃wo ƒe kaka.

text: Some men do not provide for their families, and they abandon girls after impregnating them.

text: The porcupine is a very elusive and hard animal to kill.
ref: Kotoko nye lã si womate ŋu asi le bɔbɔe o eye wòsesẽna be woawu.

ref: Woɖo aɖaŋu na amewo be woawɔ dɔ sesẽ ɖe woƒe sɔlemeha kple woƒe ƒomea ta.

text: The people of Twifo Praso used the saterlite to connect to other parts of the world.
ref: Twifo Prasotɔwo zã satelait la tsɔ do ka kple xexeame ƒe akpa bubuwo.

text: States, tribes, and local communities can create environments that are supportive of women’s health and tailored to local needs and challenges.
ref: Dukɔwo, towo, kple nutoa me tɔwo ate ŋu awɔ nɔnɔme siwo ado alɔ nyɔnuwo ƒe lãmesẽ eye woasɔ ɖe nutoa me ƒe nuhiahiãwo kple kuxiwo nu.
translated: Dukɔwo, towo, kple nutomewo ate ŋu aɖo nɔnɔmewo anyi siwo ado alɔ nyɔnuwo ƒe lãmesẽ eye wotrɔ asi le wo ŋu be woasɔ kple nutomea ƒe nuhiahiãwo kple kuxiwo.

text: This made him to come and pick some of his people to add up and to teach Asanteman sense.
ref: Esia na wòva tia eƒe amewo dometɔ aɖewo be yeatsɔ aƒo ƒu eye yeafia Asanteman sidzedze.
translated: Esia na wòva tia eƒe amewo dometɔ aɖewo tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu be wòafia nunya Asanteman.

text: This shocked her so much that she even considered taking her life, as she couldn’t see any way she could support herself with that little money each month.
ref: Esia wɔ nuku nɛ ale gbegbe be ebu eŋu gɔ̃ hã be yeaɖe yeƒe agbe ɖa, elabena mete ŋu kpɔ mɔ aɖeke si dzi yeato akpɔ ye ɖokui dzi kple ga sue ma ɣleti sia ɣleti o.
translated: Esia wɔ nuku nɛ ale gbegbe be ebu eɖokui wuwu gɔ̃ hã ŋu, elabena mekpɔ mɔ aɖeke si dzi wòato akpɔ eɖokui dzi kple ga vi ma ɣleti sia ɣleti o.

text: These elders are sometimes women who wont give birth again due to their experience to help others.
ref: Hamemetsitsi siawo nyea nyɔnu ɣeaɖewoɣi siwo magadzi vi ake o le woƒe nuteƒekpɔkpɔ be woakpe ɖe ame bubuwo ŋu ta.
translated: Ɣeaɖewoɣi la, ametsitsi siawo nye nyɔnu siwo madzi vi ake o le woƒe nuteƒekpɔkpɔ ta be woakpe ɖe ame bubuwo ŋu.

text: Border districts are greatly affected by the Pandemic.
ref: Nuto siwo me dome gblẽa nu le ŋunye la gblẽa nu le ŋutɔ.

translated: Amewo trɔ ɖe ameha ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋu be woatsɔ akpɔ anyigba ŋuti masɔmasɔ siwo le edzi yim la gbɔ.

ref: Aʋawɔla si le míaƒe aƒelikawo gbɔ va míaƒe aƒe me.
translated: Nutome dedienɔnɔ dzikpɔla la ge ɖe nye aƒelika ƒe aƒe me sesẽe.

text: In a case where two or more people were heading to a place and one or some of them decided to take the lead, when they got to a junction, they put leaves on the path they took so as to inform the others behind them of where they passed.
ref: Le nya aɖe si me ame eve alo esi wu nenema ɖo ta teƒe aɖe eye wo dometɔ ɖeka alo wo dometɔ aɖewo tso nya me be yewoaxɔ ŋgɔ la, ne woɖo mɔdodo aɖe dzi la, wotsɔa aŋgbawo dana ɖe mɔ si dzi woto la dzi ale be woana ame mamlɛ siwo le megbe na wo la nanya afi si wole woto eme va yi.

text: Women believe in traditional birth attendants more than in hospital staff.
ref: Nyɔnuwo ate ŋu awɔ dɔ si ŋutsuwo wɔna eye woaga ate ŋu awɔ dɔwɔɖuia si ŋtsuwo wɔna hã.

translated: Emegbe la, wo dometɔ 35% te ŋu wua sekɛndrisuku (SHS) nu. Susu siwo ta gɔmedzesuku, sekɛndrisuku, kple kɔledzi wuwu ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ dzi ɖe kpɔtɔ ate ŋu anye suku dzudzɔ kaba, teƒeɖoɖo, kple suku dzudzɔ kaba.

text: First of all, social media encourages our lives.

text: In a meeting to discuss the training of teachers, the Chief Director of the Ministry of Education, Divine Ayidzoe, said that the examination will be based on two core subjects: Numeracy and Literacy.

text: Deputy Minister for Energy, Dr Mohammed Amin Adam has made known that the government is ready to exchange gold for oil; the government has made arrangements to engage in this trade.

text: Again, it is crucial for us to collaborate with our development partners in the country to alleviate the hardships faced by our citizens.
